name: Mirza Abu Bakr
seoTitle: Mirza Abu Bakr: Mughal Prince in the 1857 Delhi Resistance
seoDescription: Profile of Mirza Abu Bakr, a Mughal prince linked to Delhi resistance, rebel mobilization, and the 1857 anti-colonial uprising.
role: Mughal prince associated with Delhi resistance in 1857
contribution: He was tied to the Delhi-centered resistance during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 through leadership and mobilization.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: Remembered in 1857 historiography as part of the coalition that challenged East India Company rule.
